question: Why does Spider-Man keep worrying about his web-shooters running dry?

The story shows Peter thinking about adding a warning indicator to the shooters.
The payoff is the practical fix: he wants a way to avoid being stranded when the webs run out.

As he bounds his way home on the rooftops, Spider-Man considers the idea of upgrading his web-shooters so they have a warning indicator to tell him when he is running out of web-fluid so this situation doesn't happen again.
